title: #[forbid(unsafe_code)] at crate root enforced by compiler
description: lib.rs:7 has #[forbid(unsafe_code)]. This is a compiler-enforced invariant, not just a style preference — any future unsafe block will be a compile error. A contributor might suggest downgrading to #[deny] so it can be overridden. It should stay as #[forbid] since there is no legitimate use case for unsafe in a dispatch/parsing crate.
